summary.description: Atrazine is a white crystalline herbicide of the triazine class, used to control weed growth in agriculture. It is soluble in water and organic solvents.
emission_sources: Application as a herbicide on crops
Runoff into soils and surface waters
environmental_impact: Persistent in soils and can contaminate groundwaters
Causes skin irritation and sensitisation after prolonged dermal exposure

top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Atrazine is very persistent in soils and can contaminate groundwater, threatening the availability of safe drinking water.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Atrazine is highly toxic to aquatic organisms, posing a serious threat to freshwater and marine ecosystems through runoff and water contamination.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Its environmental toxicity and persistence highlight the need for careful regulation and sustainable agricultural practices to reduce pollution and protect ecosystems.
